g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Input into Server Interpreters I POST /rest/user/login with email set to a known address followed by `'--` and any password. C-01 · Express REST API Server No account required Database access relies on concatenated queries (W-002) Authentication is bypassed for any account, including admin, yielding full control over the synthetic customer data and admin functions. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass or Forge Authentication I copy the PEM private key literal from lib/insecurity.ts:21 in the public repository. C-01 · Express REST API Server No account required; Public source available Secrets are committed to source instead of a managed store (W-007) Every deployment shares the same signing key, so anyone with the source can mint valid admin and deluxe tokens and impersonate any account, exposing the synthetic user and card data the business context lists as assets. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass Authorization to Gain Access A signed-in attacker puts another user's ID into the owner field of the request (req.body.UserId and the like); the query trusts it instead of the session identity, so the attacker reads or changes every other user's records — horizontal privilege escalation across all accounts. C-01 · Express REST API Server No account required Authorization is implemented route by route (W-003) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Access Exposed Data and Secrets An anonymous attacker uploads a ZIP to POST /file-upload (no authentication, server.ts:309) containing an entry named `../../ftp/legal.md` or `../../frontend/dist/frontend/main.js`. extractZipBuffer resolves the entry path and only checks that it contains the application root (fileUpload.ts:33), so the file is written anywhere inside the application directory. C-01 · Express REST API Server No account required Input handling lacks enforced boundary validation (W-004) Attackers overwrite served frontend assets, FTP documents, or i18n files (autoReload at server.ts:303), defacing the shop or planting script served to every user. Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Stored script execution yields server code control I register an account and log in to obtain the token cookie. C-01 · Express REST API Server Regular account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-001) Any self-registered user gains arbitrary code execution as the Node.js process, with access to the database, signing key and host filesystem. Service disruption or compromise of application data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Scripts into Victim Browsers An attacker sends a victim a link such as /#/search?q=<iframe src="javascript:...">; the search component marks the q parameter as trusted HTML and Angular inserts it into the page, running attacker script that reads the JWT from localStorage. C-05 · Angular SPA Frontend No account required; Victim interaction required Frontend rendering lacks enforced output encoding (W-006) Script execution in the shop origin lets the attacker steal the victim's bearer token and act as them, including admins. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Abuse Cross-Site Requests An attacker obtains a Google access token for their own account and sends the victim a link to the shop ending in #access_token=<attacker token>; the OAuth route accepts any fragment containing access_token and logs the victim into the attacker's account, capturing addresses or payment data the victim enters. C-05 · Angular SPA Frontend Victim interaction required OAuth sign-in requests are not bound to the user's browser session (W-011) Login CSRF: the victim operates inside an attacker-controlled account, so data they enter (addresses, cards, complaints) becomes readable by the attacker. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Supply-Chain / Build Attacker 1 role; access details in Identified Actors Compromise the Build or Its Inputs I take over a maintainer account of a transitive dependency and publish a malicious in-range patch version. C-08 · CI/CD Pipeline and Build Infrastructure Build or dependency access required Build pipeline trusts mutable third-party references (W-005) Arbitrary code runs in the image build and on CI runners, and a trojanized Docker image and release archives reach the security practitioners worldwide who pull the public training artifact; the declared harm of a compromised public image is directly reachable. Service disruption or compromise of application data
g.text: Compromise the Build or Its Inputs
